decisionChannel: Founder answers to interactive questions in the orchestrator chat, 2026-11-02, recorded verbatim by the derived docs-and-closer track

decisions.item: Keychain and mach-service route for the dedicated lab user (NC-5 open question)

decision.keychain: only the dedicated lab user's own keychain
decision.machServices: a closed list of mach services
decision.observation: T009 observes which services claude requests
decision.additions: any new service needs a review and a decision record before it is added to the profile
decision.founderKeychain: the founder's personal keychain is never reachable (different user)

decisions.detail: Matches the RV-21 disposition: each profile addition needs a decision record, a catalog extension for the opened class (RV-08) and a delta review. If securityd is allowed, CRED-02 becomes a test against the dedicated user's login keychain content, and this is stated before it runs.

decisions.item: Credential readable by the child and exfiltration through the allowed API host

bounds: credential belongs to a revocable dedicated user

decisions.detail: Documented as an explicit residual risk. Probes cannot show this and no catalog entry may claim it is covered.

decisions.item: Bound on total disk use and file count

decision.enforcement: supervisor measures the candidate directory plus TMPDIR on each poll and kills the session above 2 GB total or 100,000 files

decisions.detail: New NC-8 values, implemented as a T005 fix in a follow-up track before T009. 2 GB is read as 2 x 1024^3 bytes unless the implementing track records a different convention.

limits: Records founder decisions on the three needs-founder-decision findings of the SPEC-065 T008 review only. No native session, probe or account setup was performed, no code changed, and nothing here qualifies the Claude profile, issues a qualification record, authorizes T009, accepts the T002 ADR, completes SPEC-048/T008 or admits SPEC-049/T004. The fix-in-T005 and fix-in-T007 findings remain to be fixed in follow-up tracks and delta-reviewed before T009. Any change needs a new founder decision record.
